title: Excuse Genereator
description: A client-side Minecraft mod that gives you a random PvP excuse when you type /excuse.
body:
# Excuse Generator

Excuse Generator is a simple client-side Minecraft mod that gives you a random excuse after losing a PvP fight.

Just type:

`/excuse`

And the mod will show a random excuse in your local chat.

## Features

- Fully client-side
- Adds the `/excuse` command
- Shows a random PvP excuse
- Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
- The message is only visible to you
- The server does not need this mod
- Other players do not need this mod
- No gameplay advantage
- No server-side features

## Examples

- “I swear that hit looked clean on my screen.”
- “The server showed me a completely different fight.”
- “My cat jumped on my keyboard in the middle of the fight.”
- “A dinosaur destroyed half of my house during the final trade.”

## Important

Excuse Generator does **not** send messages to public chat.  
The excuse is shown only on your screen.

This mod is just for fun. It does not change combat, improve PvP, or give any advantage.
